subject: Discuss AI-generated workout routines (bored / ready to progress)
description: Design discussion before building: use AI to draft a new workout routine when bored with the current one, or when ready to progress but unsure which exercises to move to. Topics to cover: inputs (exercise library + per-exercise history/progression, recent feedback difficulty/pain/form flags, available equipment, recovery data); output should be a draft WorkoutRoutine (library exercises + per-routine targets) the user reviews/edits before saving — never auto-saved; reuse GeminiAnalyzer (already sends workout/meal/sleep payloads) with a new prompt/method; AI may suggest exercises not yet in the library — create via the existing pick-or-create flow (normalized name dedup); trigger options: manual 'Suggest a routine' button vs. proactive nudge from the daily AI check-in when progression stalls or feedback shows boredom.
